integrity.finite_example_checks: exhaustive for ten stated small configurations only

scientific_limitations: Only rank-one transpose-symmetric idempotents with the standard symmetric bilinear form over finite fields of characteristic two are considered.
The graph is not the orthogonal graph of the polar form of a quadratic form; this distinction is essential in characteristic two.
Priority checks are bounded and cannot preclude an earlier equivalent calculation under alternate terminology.
title: Parity spectrum of maximal commuting rank-one symmetric idempotents in characteristic two
